# Rich Markdown

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/rich-markdown` (default export). Compound markdown with card/file reference tracking: `body` plus resolved `cardReferenceUrls`/`fileReferenceUrls`, so embedded links survive as real references.

## Usage
```ts
import RichMarkdownField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/rich-markdown';
```

Example: compound — `body` holds the markdown; reference URL arrays are maintained by the editor
